welcome:
Welcome to PaperDrop!

Send me:
- A link to any article
- An EPUB file (I'll fix it for Kindle)
- A PDF file (I'll convert it to EPUB)
- A Word document (.docx)
- A Markdown file (.md)

Commands:
/help - Usage instructions
/settings - Open settings
/history - Recent conversions
/status - Subscription status
/subscribe - Upgrade to premium
help:
Send a link or file (EPUB, PDF, DOCX, Markdown) — I'll convert it to a Kindle-ready EPUB.

Send to Kindle:
1. Open amazon.com/sendtokindle and find your Kindle email
2. Add {sender_email} to your Approved Senders list (same page)
3. Paste your Kindle email in /settings
That's it — every EPUB will land on your Kindle automatically.

Tips:
- Can't attach an EPUB? Try forwarding it from another chat, or fix it at bp-flow.com/epub-fixer first.
- Files are deleted immediately after sending. We only store metadata for your history.
